requirement: Edit captions owned by DOCX and RHWP group objects while preserving caption association, placement, text, and serialization.

supportedRhwpScope.hwpx: Group-owned caption text is addressable only through the exact group caption cell and verified rich paragraph/atno owner. HWPX group caption side, spacing, and lateral vertical alignment are exposed only for an unlocked, uniquely owned group caption; edits preserve all other group properties and child controls.
supportedRhwpScope.hwp5: Group-owned caption text is editable only through the verified group caption cell after the HWP original passes the safe preflight. This change does not enable HWP5 group caption placement editing.

implementation.rejected: DOCX group caption editing stays disabled. No owner is inferred from adjacent Caption/SEQ paragraphs, alt text, visual proximity, or a child shape.

formatContractEvidence.schemaFinding: Microsoft CT_WordprocessingGroup defines group properties and graphical child elements but no group-caption association or owner field. The current WordCraft InlineObject::Group model stores geometry, float placement, child-coordinate dimensions, children, and optional canvas, with no caption binding (external/wordcraft/crates/doc/src/para.rs).
formatContractEvidence.decision: The available contract cannot prove which caption paragraph, SEQ field, or child text shape belongs to a DOCX group. Mutating or serializing an inferred association would risk changing another object or unrelated text, so DOCX group captions remain fail-closed pending an authentic supported contract/sample.
